'''Insectoid assassins''' are [[Scabarites]] encountered during the [[Smoking Kills]] [[quest]]. Turned from the true path of [[Scabaras]], they now serve [[Amascut]], the Devourer.

Four Assassins are encountered during the quest's final battle, alongside the [[Banshee Mistress]]. When the Mistress reaches half health, the Assassins will begin to attack the players with rapid [[Ranged]] attacks from the corner of the room.

==Habitat==
* [[Pollnivneach Slayer Dungeon]] (during [[Smoking Kills]] only)
